# 对新手非常友好的12个靶场

- sqli-labs

sqli-labs包含了大多数的sql注入类型，以一种闯关模式，对于sql注入进行[漏洞利用](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=198729407&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=%E6%BC%8F%E6%B4%9E%E5%88%A9%E7%94%A8&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3OTMxMzk2MzEsInEiOiLmvI_mtJ7liKnnlKgiLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoxOTg3Mjk0MDcsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MSwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.FnpKfheWn7Pct01_hdwWqpHAM_oGm16tUcx1s8Tn2PU&zhida_source=entity)

下载地址：[https://github.com/Audi-1/sqli-labs](https://link.zhihu.com/?target=https%3A//github.com/Audi-1/sqli-labs)

- xss challenges

xsschallenges是一个专对于XSS漏洞练习的在线靶场，包含了各种绕过，各种姿势的XSS利用

下载地址：[XSS Challenges (by yamagata21)](https://link.zhihu.com/?target=http%3A//xss-quiz.int21h.jp/)

基于[跨站脚本攻击](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=198729407&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=%E8%B7%A8%E7%AB%99%E8%84%9A%E6%9C%AC%E6%94%BB%E5%87%BB&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3OTMxMzk2MzEsInEiOiLot6jnq5nohJrmnKzmlLvlh7siLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoxOTg3Mjk0MDcsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MSwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.xIq8FChkz7rnHbFW5wA7QUsBcBa_NH0UxpLM0i5onIQ&zhida_source=entity)一个漏洞靶机，也是一款基于通关形式的靶机

在线地址：[http://test.xss.tv](https://link.zhihu.com/?target=http%3A//test.xss.tv)

- upload-labs

一个帮你总结所有类型的[上传漏洞](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=198729407&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=%E4%B8%8A%E4%BC%A0%E6%BC%8F%E6%B4%9E&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3OTMxMzk2MzEsInEiOiLkuIrkvKDmvI_mtJ4iLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoxOTg3Mjk0MDcsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MSwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.5BDthlxsdr-YDCt23mhcBqbYd-pKWhv4cTjyAScS_x0&zhida_source=entity)的靶场，推荐windows(除了Pass-19必须在linux下，其余Pass都可以在windows上运行)

下载地址：[Releases · c0ny1/upload-labs](https://link.zhihu.com/?target=https%3A//github.com/c0ny1/upload-labs/releases)

- DVWA

推荐新手首选[靶场](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=198729407&content_type=Article&match_order=3&q=%E9%9D%B6%E5%9C%BA&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3OTMxMzk2MzEsInEiOiLpnbblnLoiLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoxOTg3Mjk0MDcsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MywiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9._ssc3WP9cfsnuRD-Av_rgY9m1pU8Tfcsb7ldqllmSIY&zhida_source=entity)，DVWA的目的是通过简单易用的界面来实践一些最常见的[Web漏洞](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=198729407&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=Web%E6%BC%8F%E6%B4%9E&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3OTMxMzk2MzEsInEiOiJXZWLmvI_mtJ4iLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoxOTg3Mjk0MDcsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MSwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.zDMdo3kqGTE2B1RcYYXaW4Jx-ATHNxT8Z5Db8wuaIEk&zhida_source=entity)，这些漏洞具有不同的难度，是一个涵盖了多种漏洞一个综合的[靶机](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=198729407&content_type=Article&match_order=3&q=%E9%9D%B6%E6%9C%BA&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3OTMxMzk2MzEsInEiOiLpnbbmnLoiLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoxOTg3Mjk0MDcsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MywiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.eiMX0VU-ovkh72mzqlf0zZ8PowJhZr7GqEM-RXyEARE&zhida_source=entity)

下载地址：[https://github.com/ethicalhack3r/DVWA](https://link.zhihu.com/?target=https%3A//github.com/ethicalhack3r/DVWA)

- pikachu

Pikachu是一个带有漏洞的Web应用系统，在这里包含了常见的web[安全漏洞](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=198729407&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=%E5%AE%89%E5%85%A8%E6%BC%8F%E6%B4%9E&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3OTMxMzk2MzEsInEiOiLlronlhajmvI_mtJ4iLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoxOTg3Mjk0MDcsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MSwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.EqYD6DEv_egu07FvzRMwIyMk05ggA4_E98jYcep-aiw&zhida_source=entity)

下载地址：[https://github.com/zhuifengshaonianhanlu/pikachu](https://link.zhihu.com/?target=https%3A//github.com/zhuifengshaonianhanlu/pikachu)

- 网络安全实验室

做题的靶场，也是一个基础靶场，是一个在线的靶场。

在线地址：[网络安全实验室|网络信息安全攻防学习平台](https://link.zhihu.com/?target=http%3A//hackinglab.cn/)

- **Welcome to WangDunSec**

[攻城狮竞赛靶场](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=198729407&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=%E6%94%BB%E5%9F%8E%E7%8B%AE%E7%AB%9E%E8%B5%9B%E9%9D%B6%E5%9C%BA&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3OTMxMzk2MzEsInEiOiLmlLvln47ni67nq57otZvpnbblnLoiLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoxOTg3Mjk0MDcsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MSwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.shRLRuDYOZFbNNF4QgA1ALKA5fnvFMLFlKwvWRiYd4g&zhida_source=entity)是一个漏洞集成平台，将漏洞环境 docker 镜像，放入即可使用，开箱即用。比较全的综合性靶场

- OWASP Broken Web Applications Project

靶场由OWASP专门为[Web安全](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=198729407&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=Web%E5%AE%89%E5%85%A8&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3OTMxMzk2MzEsInEiOiJXZWLlronlhagiLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoxOTg3Mjk0MDcsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MSwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.an7tXtbhrEmjz43HHFUlIlqvUbS3kmCjs0Sk4pitMPA&zhida_source=entity)研究者和初学者开发的一个靶场，包含了大量存在已知安全漏洞的训练实验环境和真实Web应用程序；

靶场在官网下载后是一个集成虚拟机，可以直接在vm中打开，物理机访问ip即可访问到web平台，使用root owaspbwa 登入就会返回靶场地址，直接可以访问靶场。

dvwa适合了解漏洞和简单的漏洞利用，owaspbwa则就更贴近实际的复杂的业务环境

下载地址：[OWASP Broken Web Applications Project](https://link.zhihu.com/?target=https%3A//sourceforge.net/projects/owaspbwa/)

这是一个开源的漏洞环境项目，包含了很多不同的环境，是owaspbwa以后，漏洞种类多，环境丰富的一个靶场，并且收集的漏洞也比较新，适合作为一个长期的学习、实战靶场。

Vulhub是一个基于docker和docker-compose的漏洞环境集合，需要在linux下安装docker，有docker环境之后，即可一条语句启动一个漏洞环境。

vulhub指导安装地址：[Docker-Compose file for vulnerability environment](https://link.zhihu.com/?target=https%3A//vulhub.org/)

- webug4.0

基础环境是基于PHP/mysql制作搭建而成，中级环境与高级环境分别都是由互联网漏洞事件而收集的漏洞存在的操作环境。部分漏洞是基于Windows操作系统的漏洞所以将WeBug的web环境都装在了一个纯净版的Windows [虚拟机](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=198729407&content_type=Article&match_order=2&q=%E8%99%9A%E6%8B%9F%E6%9C%BA&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3OTMxMzk2MzEsInEiOiLomZrmi5_mnLoiLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoxOTg3Mjk0MDcsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MiwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.atJz_PXwXP3r7AdvvAKDHWJGxNp4MRIJVnmIIBPpIRU&zhida_source=entity)中

- vulnstack

红蓝对抗，内网、[域渗透](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=198729407&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=%E5%9F%9F%E6%B8%97%E9%80%8F&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3OTMxMzk2MzEsInEiOiLln5_muJfpgI8iLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoxOTg3Mjk0MDcsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MSwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.-NptkoKUNyj0td8h0oIZGo_CbbxYo7ulWiYW3mEu6Qo&zhida_source=entity)最新靶场：

地址：[漏洞信息](https://link.zhihu.com/?target=http%3A//vulnstack.qiyuanxuetang.net/vuln/)
